svg.title: Thirty days from pain signal to cash-flowing SKU
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-08-thirty-day-launch-roadmap; chart type: timeline_roadmap; title: Thirty days from pain signal to cash-flowing SKU; subtitle: Four weekly validation, build, launch & optimization gates; chapter number: 12; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values are milestone end-days. Advance to paid scaling only after front-end unit economics clear target thresholds.; caption: Ship a focused v1.0 painkiller in 14 days, validate real checkout conversion in Week 3, and lock onboarding + affiliate leverage by Day 30.; stages: label: Mine & pre-sell; value: Days 1-7; numeric value: 7.0; detail: Audit Ad Libraries and Reddit threads, wire MoR pre-sale lander, and confirm real buyer conversion.; label: Build & wire SKU; value: Days 8-14; numeric value: 14.0; detail: Assemble modular v1.0 product, order bump, 1-click upsell, CE 3.0 webhooks, and 5-email onboarding.; label: Launch & liquidate; value: Days 15-21; numeric value: 21.0; detail: Publish YouTube/Reddit/DM triggers, activate newsletter co-reg, and run $50/day SLO split tests.; label: Audit & scale; value: Days 22-30; numeric value: 30.0; detail: Reconcile net contribution margin, cut refund friction, onboard affiliates, and scale winning hooks.
